title: WhyReport
description: Structured explanation of why a RuntimePlan was chosen. Produced by the CompatibilityResolver alongside 1..3 candidate plans. Not an immutable resource: it carries no content id (a canonical hash may still be computed for change detection; see schemas/CANONICALIZATION.md).

decisions.description: Ordered list of individual decisions that make up the recommendation.

subject.description: What the decision is about, e.g. 'precision', 'training_strategy', 'cuda_version'.

verdict.description: Whether this option was chosen or rejected.

evidence_level.description: Strength of the backing evidence on the project's evidence ladder.

summary.description: Optional one-paragraph summary of the overall recommendation.
